aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable data but misidentifies the primary changed factor and mispairs key function results.
issues: Primary change is UV Dry condition, not Normal vs Line R/Line L.
Line R and Line L are subgroup keys, not changed conditions.
Line L test is paired to the wrong Normal row.
UV Dry measurement stats use header-only evidence and wrong specs.
Review title/purpose wrongly centered on Decap sheet instead of main Test report.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Normal UV Dry vs Test UV Dry condition, with dry note as secondary context.
Keep Line R/Line L and machine areas as subgroup keys.
Pair Line R Test row 26 with Normal row 28; pair Line L Test row 30 with Normal row 32.
Cite UV Dry condition rows 11 and 14-21 for peak/total comparisons.
Use Decap NG sheet only as supplemental defect-analysis context if linked to the same validation.
